title: Hai rukhsat  ki ghadi ae karbala  walo
body:
Hai rukhsat ki ghadi ae karbala waalo khudahafiz
salaame aaqri hai ae karbala waalo khudahafiz
<<DIVIDER>>
tumhaare saath zahra bhi yahaa'n tashreef laati thi
ye izzat bhi mili ae karbala waalo khudahafiz
<<DIVIDER>>
hamaare ghar ki rounaq bhi tumhaare saath jaati hai
udaasi chaa gayi ae karbala waalo khudahafiz
<<DIVIDER>>
kuch aansu aankh me kuch daagh hai maatam ke seene par
hai nazraana yahi ae karbala waalo khudahafiz
<<DIVIDER>>
tumhaare gham me rote rote marjaate to acha tha
ye hasrat reh gayi ae karbala waalo khudahafiz
<<DIVIDER>>
na hum se ho saka kuch bhi ada haq mezbaani ka
hai ye sharmindagi ae karbala waalo khudahafiz
